import datetime, os, shutil
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792

HEL = {"A":667,"u":556,"g":556,"s":500,"t":278," ":278,"1":556,"7":556,",":278,"2":556,"0":556,"6":556}

def tw(text, table, size):
    return sum(table.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * size

def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

def build_cover(out):
    title_x = (PAGE_W - tw(TITLE, HB, 28)) / 2.0
    date_x = (PAGE_W - tw(DATE_STR, HEL, 14)) / 2.0
    lines = [
        "BT", "/F1 28 Tf", "0.09 0.18 0.40 rg",
        "%.2f %.2f Td" % (title_x, PAGE_H - 280), "(%s) Tj" % esc(TITLE), "ET",
        "0.35 0.35 0.35 RG", "%.2f %.2f m %.2f %.2f l S" % (100, PAGE_H - 330, PAGE_W - 100, PAGE_H - 330),
        "BT", "/F2 14 Tf", "0.25 0.25 0.25 rg",
        "%.2f %.2f Td" % (date_x, PAGE_H - 360), "(%s) Tj" % esc(DATE_STR), "ET",
    ]
    stream = "\n".join(lines).encode("latin-1")
    objects = {
        1: b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        2: b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        3: ("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %d %d] "
            "/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> "
            "/Contents 6 0 R >>" % (PAGE_W, PAGE_H)).encode("latin-1"),
        4: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        5: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        6: ("<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream)).encode("latin-1") + stream + b"\nendstream",
    }
    header = b"%PDF-1.4\n"
    body = b""
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objects):
        offsets[num] = len(header) + len(body)
        body += ("%d 0 obj\n" % num).encode("latin-1") + objects[num] + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_offset = len(header) + len(body)
    xref = b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1) + b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in sorted(objects):
        xref += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]).encode("latin-1")
    trailer = (b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (len(objects) + 1, xref_offset))
    with open(out, "wb") as f:
        f.write(header + body + xref + trailer)

cover_path = "_cover_tmp.pdf"
merged_path = "_merged_tmp.pdf"
build_cover(cover_path)
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(PdfReader(cover_path).pages[0])
for page in PdfReader("report.pdf").pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
with open(merged_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
shutil.move(merged_path, "report.pdf")
os.remove(cover_path)
print("Done. Pages now:", len(PdfReader("report.pdf").pages), "| Date:", DATE_STR)
